required_nodes.rationale: Real issuance, Ed25519 authentication, fresh registry verification, and exact control-plane projection succeed end to end.
Partial configuration fails deterministically while the default authenticated path remains compatible.
Revoked and invalid-window snapshots are bounded descriptions with invariant proof budget and admission.
A future revocation is current before, and revoked exactly at, its effective time.
Currentness runs once, after provenance only, using the one observation timestamp.
Binding, unusable configuration, and verifier availability failures are classified without exception leakage.
Caller smuggling is ignored and successful currentness does not change policy or admission.
The composition exposes no allocation, entitlement, effect, issuance, or registry administration operation.
